title: Assessment Pattern Library and Pack Effectiveness Foundation
goal: Create a local learning layer from prior assessments without training on or exporting customer data.
scope: Add a local assessment-pattern and pack-effectiveness analysis layer that summarizes recurring findings, proposal outcomes, remediation persistence, and pack-quality signals from stored AegisPT records. Output must remain advisory, tenant-safe, and local, with no external model training or automatic pack promotion.
generation_reason: AI_PENTESTING_AGENT.md describes an intelligence flywheel for assessment patterns, customer risk posture, and pack effectiveness feedback.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Local advisory analytics only. Do not train external models, share customer data, auto-promote packs, or weaken tenant isolation.

success_criteria: Assessment patterns are derived from local stored records and scoped by engagement or tenant boundaries.
Pack effectiveness output is advisory and does not promote, deploy, or mutate packs automatically.
Customer risk posture signals distinguish persistent, remediated, recurring, and new patterns without overclaiming risk reduction.
No customer assessment data is sent to third-party training or analytics systems.
Tests cover tenant boundaries, advisory output, sparse data, and no automatic pack promotion.
must_not_touch: pack approval, deployment, or runtime binding bypasses

acceptance_criteria: Pattern outputs are local, tenant-safe, and advisory.
Pack effectiveness does not bypass validation or approval gates.
No customer data is exported for training.

before_promotion: AI-augmented attack path and lateral analysis foundation is completed and logged.
Local pattern boundaries and tenant isolation requirements are documented.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with assessment pattern library changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with intelligence-flywheel baseline and customer-data limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
